newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina passes tough new tax law.
newsitem.headline: Argentina passes tough new tax law.

text.p: Argentina's Senate Thursday passed a new law boosting penalties against tax dodgers to include jail and raising fines.

In a measure to crack down on avoidance of value-added tax, the law also allows for consumers to be fined up to $2,500 if they are unable to show receipts to inspectors on leaving shop premises after buying goods.
The tough new measures follow another law -- passed Wednesday -- which allows the tax department to shut down businesses which are dodging taxes.
The government estimates that $20 billion in taxes are evaded every year in Argentina -- equivalent to half the country's annual public expenditure.
